definitions.text_mt: Għeluqija: il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li tkun dejqa. id-dejjaq

usage_examples.english: This road has too much narrowness.
The narrowness of the room makes it uncomfortable.

definitions.text_mt: Għemeż: fetaħ u għalaq għajnu malajr. għamel sinjal bl-għajn

usage_examples.english: He winked at me to let me know.

usage_examples.maltese: Tieqaf tgħameż u isma' x'għandi x'ngħidlek.
usage_examples.english: Stop winking and listen to what I have to tell you.

definitions.text_mt: Għemiż: l-att li wieħed jagħmeż b'għajnu. it-tgħammiż
Għemiż: tgħammiża. sinjal bl-għajn

usage_examples.english: I recognised him from the wink he gave me.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-għemiż kontinwu jista' jkun sinjal nervuż.
usage_examples.english: Continuous winking can be a nervous sign.

definitions.text_mt: Għen: ta l-għajnuna. għamel xi ħaġa ta' ġid għal xi ħadd. mexxa idejh

usage_examples.english: Help me carry the bags, please.

usage_examples.maltese: Dawn il-mediċini jgħinu kontra l-uġigħ ta' ras.
usage_examples.english: These medicines help against headaches.

definitions.text_mt: Għeneb: frotta żgħira u tonda li tikber fi gruppi fuq id-dielja, ta' lewn aħdar, aħmar jew vjola, li tintuża biex isir l-inbid u l-żbib

usage_examples.english: The ripe grapes are ready for harvesting in September.

usage_examples.maltese: Qegħdin nagħmlu l-inbid mill-għeneb li kabbarna.
usage_examples.english: We are making wine from the grapes we grew.
I bought a red grape from the market today.

definitions.text_en: small bunch, small cluster (diminutive of għanqud)
definitions.text_mt: Għenejqed: għanqud żgħir. grupp żgħir ta' frott jew fjuri

usage_examples.maltese: Għenejqed żgħir ta' għeneb kiber fil-ġnien.
usage_examples.english: A small bunch of grapes grew in the garden.
The small bunches of flowers were beautiful.

definitions.text_mt: Għenelli: jidhirli. naħseb. skont l-opinjoni tiegħi

usage_examples.maltese: Għenelli li llum se tagħmel ix-xita.
usage_examples.english: It seems to me that it will rain today.

usage_examples.maltese: Għenelli li mhux se jasal fil-ħin.
usage_examples.english: It seems to me that he will not arrive on time.

definitions.text_mt: Għens: mogħos maskili. mogħa maskili

usage_examples.english: The billygoat started climbing onto the rocks.
The billygoats graze in the pasture.

definitions.text_en: yelp (a short, high-pitched cry or bark, especially made by a young puppy before it learns to bark properly)
definitions.text_mt: Għepp: għajta qasira u ta' ton għoli, speċjalment ta' ġeru qabel ma jitgħallem jinbaħ sewwa

usage_examples.english: We heard the yelp of the puppy in the yard.
The yelping of the puppies is heard from afar.

definitions.text_mt: Għepp: għamel għajta qasira u ta' ton għoli, speċjalment ta' ġeru (użat għall-ġriewi)

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġeru beda jgħepp meta ra lil sidu.
usage_examples.english: The puppy started yipping when it saw its owner.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ġriewi jgħeppu l-lejl kollu jekk iħossuhom waħedhom.
usage_examples.english: The puppies yip all night if they feel lonely.

definitions.text_mt: Għer: ħass l-għira jew ir-rgħiba lejn xi ħadd minħabba s-suċċess jew il-possedimenti tiegħu
Għer: xtaq li kellu dak li għandu ħaddieħor

usage_examples.maltese: Kien jgħir għalih għax għandu karozza ġdida.
usage_examples.english: He was jealous of him because he has a new car.

usage_examples.maltese: Tgħirx għal ħaddieħor; kun kuntent b'dak li għandek.
usage_examples.english: Do not envy others; be happy with what you have.

definitions.text_mt: Għera: l-istat li wieħed ikun għeri. nuqqas ta' ħwejjeġ. nudità

usage_examples.maltese: L-għera fil-pittura u l-iskultura hija forma ta' espressjoni artistika.
usage_examples.english: Nudity in painting and sculpture is a form of artistic expression.

usage_examples.maltese: L-għera tal-ġisem m'għandhiex tkun meqjusa bħala xi ħaġa mistħija.
usage_examples.english: The nakedness of the body should not be seen as something shameful.

definitions.text_mt: Għereq: ħareġ l-għaraq minn ġismu minħabba s-sħana, l-isforz jew il-biża'
Għereq: nebba' minn ġismu xi likwidu bħal demm jew ħalib
Għereq: tilef ħajtu fl-ilma minħabba li ma setax jieħu n-nifs
Għereq: mar mal-qiegħ. tilef il-wiċċ (ta' bastiment)
Għereq: għatta għalkollox bl-ilma. għodos

usage_examples.maltese: Għereq kollu wara li dam jiġri.
usage_examples.english: He was all sweaty after running for a long time.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-vapur għereq wara li laqat is-sikka.
usage_examples.english: The ship sank after hitting the reef.

usage_examples.maltese: Kważi għereq fil-baħar meta kien żgħir.
usage_examples.english: He almost drowned in the sea when he was young.

definitions.text_mt: Għerf: għarfien profond u għaqal akkwistati permezz tal-esperjenza jew l-istudju

usage_examples.english: He is known for his wisdom in the community.
Wisdom comes with age and experience.

definitions.text_mt: Għeri: mingħajr ħwejjeġ. bla libsa. mikxuf

usage_examples.english: Babies often stay naked in summer.
The model was naked for the painting.

definitions.text_en: rubbing, friction. verbal noun of għorok
definitions.text_mt: Għerik: l-att tal-għorok. il-ħakk. il-frizzjoni bejn żewġ uċuħ

usage_examples.english: The rubbing of the rope burnt my hands.
After continuous friction, the tyre burst.

definitions.text_mt: Għerq: il-parti ta' pjanta li tikber taħt l-art u tassorbi l-ilma u n-nutrijenti
Għerq: nervatura. ħajja jew fibra fil-ġisem li tħoss l-uġigħ
Għerq: bidu, sors, oriġini ta' xi ħaġa

usage_examples.english: The roots of the tree are deep.
The root of the problem is communication.
This word has Arabic roots.

definitions.text_mt: Għerusija: il-perjodu ta' żmien bejn il-ftehim taż-żwieġ u ż-żwieġ innifsu. l-istat ta' min ikun għarus jew għarusa

usage_examples.english: The betrothal lasted two years before the wedding.
They celebrated their betrothal with a party.

definitions.text_mt: Għesaw: isem ta' raġel mill-Bibbja, iben il-kbir ta' Iżakk u ħu Ġakobb

usage_examples.maltese: L-istorja ta' Għesaw u Ġakobb tinsab fil-Ktieb tal-Ġenesi.
usage_examples.english: The story of Esau and Jacob is in the Book of Genesis.

usage_examples.maltese: Għesaw biegħ il-bikrija tiegħu lil ħuh Ġakobb.
usage_examples.english: Esau sold his birthright to his brother Jacob.

definitions.text_mt: Għex: baqa' ħaj. dam ħaj. kellu l-ħajja
Għex: kellu r-residenza permanenti tiegħu f'post. stabbilixxa
Għex: għadda minn esperjenza. esperjenza xi ħaġa

usage_examples.english: He lived a long and happy life.
I have been living in Malta since I was born.
He lived through a difficult experience in his youth.

definitions.text_en: the quality of being amazing, astonishing, surprising
definitions.text_mt: Għeġubija: il-kwalità li tkun tal-għaġeb. l-istat li xi ħaġa tqanqal l-istagħġib
Għeġubija: xi ħaġa li tqanqal l-għaġeb. meravilja
Għeġubija: meravilja. ħaġa tal-għaġeb

usage_examples.english: Nature is full of wonders.
The Pyramids are one of the wonders of the world.

definitions.text_mt: Għeżejżen: daqsxejn għażżien. pjuttost għażżien

usage_examples.maltese: Huwa għeżejżen u ma tantx iħobb jaħdem.
usage_examples.english: He is somewhat lazy and does not really like working.

usage_examples.maltese: Ibni għeżejżen illum u ma jridx jagħmel id-dmirijiet.
usage_examples.english: My son is somewhat lazy today and does not want to do his homework.

definitions.text_mt: Għeżubija: l-istat ta' raġel li għadu ma żżewwiġx. ħajja ta' għażeb

usage_examples.english: His bachelorhood gave him the opportunity to travel.

usage_examples.maltese: Illum il-ġurnata l-għeżubija hija għażla ta' ħafna.
usage_examples.english: Nowadays bachelorhood is a choice for many.

definitions.text_mt: Għid: jum ta' festa jew ċelebrazzjoni, ħafna drabi ta' natura reliġjuża
Għid: btala. jum ta' mistrieħ jew ferħ
Għid: ċelebrazzjoni. tiġrifa

usage_examples.maltese: L-Għid il-Kbir huwa l-akbar festa Nisranija.
usage_examples.english: Easter is the greatest Christian feast.

usage_examples.maltese: F'Malta, kull raħal jiċċelebra l-għid tal-patrun tiegħu.
usage_examples.english: In Malta, every village celebrates its patron saint's feast.

definitions.text_mt: Għid il-Ħamiem: il-festa Nisranija li tfakkar iż-żjara tal-Maġi lit-tarbija Ġesù, ċċelebrata fis-6 ta' Jannar. it-Tre Reġija

usage_examples.maltese: Għid il-Ħamiem jiġi ċċelebrat fis-6 ta' Jannar.
usage_examples.english: Epiphany is celebrated on the 6th of January.

usage_examples.maltese: F'Malta, Għid il-Ħamiem huwa btala pubblika.
usage_examples.english: In Malta, Epiphany is a public holiday.
